_about: GET https://api.skkuverse.com <path> with Accept-Language ko, en and zh, captured from production 2026-10-21 13:51:41Z-13:53:03Z (22:51-22:53 KST, Wednesday, after the day's last shuttle run), source commit 607051df on dev (production ran main, which differs only in the smart view of a suspension starting after today, and no service was suspended). Each entry is the status, the parsed body, ETag, Cache-Control and Vary as served; Cloudflare's own accept-encoding Vary is dropped. Trimmed: a /bus/config/:groupId body is not kept, since it equals { meta, data: that group of /bus/config } (checked when this file was built), only its ETag; a /smart body is kept as its `data` without meta.lang, once per service under "*" when the three languages differ only in meta.lang (checked), else per language; a /week body is kept once, since the three languages answered the same bytes (checked); realtime keeps only status, groupId and stationsVersion, since its buses are live.
